episodes.program:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
    (let* ((h (obj-h obj))
           (w (obj-w obj))
           (color (cond [(> h w) 2] [(> w h) 3] [else 4])))
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color))))

(rule!
  (lambda (g)
    (let* ([objs (objects g 0)]
           [anchor (if (empty? objs) #f (argmax obj-size objs))]
           [rh (if anchor (obj-h anchor) 1)]
           [rw (if anchor (obj-w anchor) 1)])
      (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list objs)])
        (let* ([left (* (obj-h obj) rw)]
               [right (* (obj-w obj) rh)]
               [color (cond [(> left right) 2] [(< left right) 3] [else 4])])
          (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color))))))

limits: Finite declared-rival audit; not universal identifiability or model evidence.
All rival executions must return valid grids; runtime errors are audit failures.
For axes, height-minus-width versus zero is mathematically equivalent to canonical aspect.
Eight-separated sampling does not distinguish 4-connectivity from 8-connectivity.

(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ([objs (objects g 0)]
             [anchor (if (empty? objs) #f (argmax obj-size objs))]
             [rh (if anchor (obj-h anchor) 1)]
             [rw (if anchor (obj-w anchor) 1)])

        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list objs)])

axes.fill_bounding_boxes:
(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ([objs (objects g 0)]
             [anchor (if (empty? objs) #f #f)]
             [rh (if anchor (obj-h anchor) 1)]
             [rw (if anchor (obj-w anchor) 1)])
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list objs)])
          (let* ([left (* (obj-h obj) rw)] [right (* (obj-w obj) rh)] [color (cond [(> left right) 2] [(< left right) 3] [else 4])])
            (paint-cells out (for*/list ([r (in-range (obj-r1 obj) (+ 1 (obj-r2 obj)))]
                               [c (in-range (obj-c1 obj) (+ 1 (obj-c2 obj)))])
                       (list r c)) color))))))
axes.group_by_color:
(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ([objs (map (lambda (color)
                       (let ([cells (find-color g color)])
                         (hash 'color color 'cells cells 'bbox (bbox-of-cells cells)
                               'size (length cells))))
                     (grid-colors g 0))]
             [anchor (if (empty? objs) #f #f)]
             [rh (if anchor (obj-h anchor) 1)]
             [rw (if anchor (obj-w anchor) 1)])
